title: clamp wrong boundary logic
description: clamp(n, lo, hi) should constrain n to the inclusive range [lo, hi], but it returns lo whenever n is above hi, and hi whenever n is below lo, so the bounds are swapped.

hidden_tests.test_clamp.py:
from clamp import clamp


def test_clamp():
    assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
    assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0
    assert clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10
    assert clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0
